title: Spicy Prawn and King Prawn Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-style stir fry made with succulent prawns, crispy king prawns, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the carrots and king prawns and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the prawns are pink and the carrots are tender.
Add the raw prawns and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until they are pink and cooked through.
Add the curry paste and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
